title: Material Design system icons
lede: Google’s set of simple 24 dp interface glyphs, drawn on one grid with the same stroke, corners, and flat gray fill.
summary: A grid of flat gray interface glyphs with 2 dp strokes and square-cut geometry. Google, 2014.

evidence.note: Opened the system icon overview *style-icons-system-intro.png* (1520 × 730) from the Material Design 1 icons page on 28 September 2026. Checked the repository date and license through the GitHub API for [google/material-design-icons](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons).

styles.note: The standard glyph set of the style. Every Material 1 and 2 app bar, list, and action button uses these icons or ones drawn to the same rules.

context: The Material Design 1 icons page separates product icons (see [Material product icons](ref:material-product-icons-2014)) from system icons, which are simple glyphs for actions and objects. It shows the system icons on a keyline grid. [Icons](https://m1.material.io/style/icons.html).

Google publishes the icons in the repository google/material-design-icons under the Apache License 2.0. The GitHub API gives the creation date as 8 October 2014. [GitHub](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons).
observed: Seventy-two icons in six rows, all in one mid-gray (about #757575) on a near-white ground.
Strokes have one weight throughout. Ends are cut square, and corners of outlined shapes are slightly rounded.
Glyphs mix solid shapes (camera, envelope, bookmark) with outlines (heart, cloud, circle with plus). None has a gradient, a highlight, or a shadow.
interpretation: The icons carry the flat half of the style. Depth in Material belongs to surfaces, not to glyphs, so an icon stays flat even when it sits on a raised button.
borrow: Draw interface icons on a 24 px grid with one stroke weight and square ends, and color them with the secondary text color (black at 54 %) instead of pure black.

images.alt: Grid of seventy-two flat gray interface icons in six rows, including a printer, globe, pin, camera, shopping cart, envelope, bell, heart, cloud, arrows, and a plus sign.
images.caption: System icon overview from the [Material Design 1 guidelines, Icons](https://m1.material.io/style/icons.html). Google, Apache License 2.0.

rights.statement: Borderline tier A, for the curator to confirm. The icons are not public domain, but Google licenses them under the Apache License 2.0, both in the [icon repository](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons) and on m1.material.io (“All content and code on this site are licensed under the Apache 2 license unless otherwise specified”).
